Name: Syntyche
Summary: Syntyche was a Philippian believer whom Paul beseeches, along with Euodias, to be of the same mind in the Lord.
KeyStory: Syntyche was a Philippian believer whom Paul beseeches, along with Euodias, to be of the same mind in the Lord.
LifeLesson: Disagreement between two faithful people is settled in the Lord, not by taking sides.
